description: Read the comments on exactly ONE of an item, a ticket or an order — the same one-target shape add_comment takes, so reading back what you just wrote is a one-word swap. Newest first, capped at 50 (`truncated` says the cap was hit). Use it before commenting to see whether the question was already answered, to follow a handover thread on an order, and to verify your own write. Each comment carries `authorName`, the `text`, `createdAt` with its UTC ISO twin `createdAtIso` — read the ISO one; this server has no timezone and does no timezone conversion — and `editedAt` when it was changed after posting. `viaAgent: true` marks a comment that an AI agent wrote on that person's behalf — your own comments through this connection carry it; its absence means the person typed it themselves, and the distinction is worth stating when you summarize a thread. You see exactly the comments the connected user sees in the app: order comments need them to be a participant (requester, assignee or an order manager).

orderId.description: Order id (exactly one target) — find it with list_orders

ticketId.description: Ticket id (exactly one target) — find it with list_tickets

name: list_comments

createdAtIso.description: When it was posted, ISO-8601 UTC timestamp — read THIS one; the server does no timezone conversion

editedAt.description: Epoch milliseconds — absent when never edited

editedAtIso.description: When it was last edited, ISO-8601 UTC timestamp

viaAgent.description: Present and true when an AI agent wrote it on that person's behalf. Absent = they typed it themselves

truncated.description: The 50-comment cap was hit — older comments exist in the app

title: List comments
